answers.charter-meetings: The ethics and compliance committee must meet **at least four times per year**. It must also meet with the audit committee at least annually.
answers.charter-min-directors: Under excerpt [1], the ethics and compliance committee must consist of **no fewer than three non-employee directors**. Each must meet the New York Stock Exchange standards for director independence.
answers.charter-term-length: Committee members are appointed by the board, on the recommendation of the directors and corporate governance committee, **for one-year terms** [1]. They serve such terms as the board may determine, or until their earlier removal, resignation, or death [1].
answers.charter-financial-oversight: The **audit committee** has sole oversight over matters of financial compliance, including accounting, auditing, financial reporting, and related investor disclosures [1]. The ethics and compliance committee has primary oversight of all other areas ("non-financial compliance"), and the two committees meet jointly at least annually to review major non-financial compliance matters [1].
answers.charter-section-name: According to the Composition and Term section [1], **the board designates the chair** of the Ethics and Compliance Committee.
answers.redbook-report-concern: Under the Red Book, anyone, whether working for Lilly or not, can submit concerns about possible violations of laws and regulations, the Red Book, or company policies or procedures at https://speakup.lilly.com [1]. The Supplier Code of Business Conduct also directs reports of known or suspected violations to Lilly sponsors or the Lilly Ethics & Compliance Hotline (www.lillyethics.ethicspoint.com, or call 1-800-815-2481) [2][3].
answers.redbook-values: Lilly's values are **Integrity, Excellence, and Respect for People**. Lilly expects its suppliers and employees to conduct Lilly business consistent with these values and its high standards of corporate conduct [2][4].
answers.redbook-last-step: The last step is **Step 5: Reflect and Learn**. It asks what went well, what could be improved, and whether there are lessons to share with your team.
answers.redbook-ai-bias: The Red Book says Lilly strives "to mitigate any inherent bias or discrimination in data, information, or algorithms" when using Artificial Intelligence (AI). This is part of its commitment to the responsible use of AI, which also includes protecting against unintended applications, unintended access, and harm, and promoting transparency in the use of AI.
answers.redbook-investigations: Yes. Investigation details, including discipline, are treated as confidential [1].
answers.supplier-excluded-employee: A supplier must report to Lilly **within five (5) calendar days** if one of its employees is excluded or restricted in any way from doing business with any government [1][2].
answers.supplier-death-report: Under the Lilly Supplier Code of Business Conduct, any known or suspected death or suspect product must be reported **immediately (within 24 hours of receipt)**. In the US, report it by calling The Lilly Answers Center (TLAC) at 1.800.LillyRx (1.800.545.5979) or by using an alternative reporting method as determined by the Lilly component.
answers.supplier-hotline-number: The Lilly Ethics & Compliance Hotline number is **1-800-815-2481**. Reports can also be made online at www.lillyethics.ethicspoint.com or to Lilly sponsors.
answers.supplier-cooperative-learning: This is not covered in the provided policy documents.
answers.supplier-impaired: No. Under the Lilly Supplier Code of Business Conduct, "we ensure that we are not impaired with drugs or alcohol while at work so that we can be fully engaged" [1][2]. This falls under the commitment to "bring our full selves to work each day" [1][2].
answers.charter-statutes-reworded: The **ethics and compliance committee** handles this. It reviews and identifies **legal and regulatory trends and issues** that may affect the company's **business operations, financial performance or reputation**. When appropriate, it brings them to the attention of the **board of directors**.
answers.charter-statutes-typo: The **ethics and compliance committee** is responsible. Under its charter, the committee "shall review, identify, and when appropriate bring to the attention of the board of directors legal and regulatory trends and issues" that may affect the company's "business operations, financial performance or reputation."
answers.supplier-adverse-event: Report any known or suspected death or suspect product immediately (within 24 hours of receipt), and report any other adverse event or product complaint within one business day. Outside the US, select your location from the globe link in the upper right corner of Lilly.com, then click "Contact" or "Contact Us" in the top menu bar to access the appropriate local reporting method.
answers.retaliation: No. Lilly "does not tolerate retaliation for reporting inappropriate conduct, preventing unlawful practices, or participating in an investigation," and takes "appropriate measures to prevent retaliation against persons who make these reports." Lilly also commits to resolving concerns and issues "in an appropriate manner, without retaliation."
answers.supplier-purchasing: Before purchasing goods or services, authorization from procurement and appropriate supporting documentation are required [1][2]. The excerpts differ on additional requirements. Excerpt [1] also requires an assessment by third party risk management and specifies "supporting contractual documentation," while excerpt [2] does not mention either. The excerpts do not indicate which version is current.
answers.supplier-gifts-on-behalf: **No, not without prior written approval.** Lilly does not allow its suppliers to offer gifts or donations on Lilly's behalf without prior written approval [1][2].
answers.supplier-current-version: The most recent version in the excerpts is **V15.0 (©2025)** [2]. An earlier **Version 13.0 (©2021)** also appears [1], but the excerpts do not explicitly label either version as "current."
answers.vacation-days: This is not covered in the provided policy documents.
